verbatim_quote.original: VERDICT: REJECT the 5-second auto-advance countdown. Launching the Bazaar/Myket purchase flow without an explicit tap breaks store consent rules.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: VERDICT: REJECT the 5-second auto-advance countdown. Launching the Bazaar/Myket purchase flow without an explicit tap breaks store consent rules.

extracted_decision.summary: Rejected the 5-second auto-advance countdown on the purchase sheet; explicit tap only; keep the pre-selected hero package.
extracted_decision.rationale: Launching the store purchase flow without an explicit tap breaks store consent rules.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Lower short-term conversion vs store policy and user trust.
